transcript: Three signs, your lungs may be full of mucus and you should never ignore them. In ancient Chinese wellness, when the lungs become heavy with what we call hidden dampness, your body sends clear warnings long before you notice what's happening. Here are the three most common signs. 1. You're constantly coughing up phlegm or mucus. No matter how much you try not to, your body is simply trying to clear the airways and release what built up inside. 2. You make a hissing or rattling sound when you breathe or sleep. Sometimes even your partner notices it before you do, because this sound happens when mucus vibrates in the airways. 3. Shortness of breath, especially during simple physical activity, not wheezing, just that quiet tightness, like your lungs can't fully expand. A gentle remedy to help your lungs feel lighter, a warm cup of malin tea with a little time. Malin has been used for generations to support a clear, open feeling in the chest, and time adds warmth that helps loosen heaviness so you can breathe more deeply and calmly. Sip slowly. Let your breath soften. Let your lungs release what they've been holding. If you wish to learn more of the wisdom I've gathered over the years, you can find my healing e-book in the link on my profile.
